fusions.name: Hoof Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a hoof at the target, dealing 4 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Rearing Lash
fusions.desc: Rears and lashes out with both forehooves, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Startle Bound
fusions.desc: Bounds you 5 tiles forward, and your movement speed rises 25% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Bolt for Cover
fusions.desc: When your health falls below half, you regain 25 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.
